# Library

> A small library for talking to a remote service.

## Rate limits

Requests over the limit get HTTP 429. Read the retry-after header and retry
with exponential backoff.

### Response headers

retry-after: seconds to wait before the next request.

## Errors

### HTTP errors

429 means the account hit a rate limit. 500 means the service failed.

## Streaming

Streaming responses arrive as server-sent events, one event per line.
